questions.question: Born on this day in 1971, which Australian entertainer starred on Young Talent Time before playing Emma Jackson in the soap opera Home and Away?
questions.explanation: Dannii Minogue made early television appearances on Young Talent Time and Home and Away before establishing a successful music career.
questions.context:
On this day in 1971: Dannii Minogue, Australian singer-songwriter and actress
Dannii Minogue (Australian singer and actress (born 1971)): Danielle Jane Minogue is an Australian singer, television personality, and actress. She first appeared on the television talent show Young Talent Time (1982–1988) before gaining recognition for her role as Emma Jackson on the soap opera Home and Away (1988–1990).

questions.question: Which veteran actor reprised his role alongside Ramya Krishnan and Yogi Babu in Nelson Dilipkumar's action comedy sequel Jailer 2?
questions.explanation: Rajinikanth returned to star in Jailer 2, following up the success of the 2023 original directed by Nelson Dilipkumar.
questions.context: Jailer 2 (2026 Indian film by Nelson Dilipkumar): Jailer 2 is a 2026 Indian Tamil-language action comedy film written and directed by Nelson Dilipkumar. It was produced by Kalanithi Maran through Sun Pictures. A sequel to Jailer (2023), the film stars Rajinikanth, Ramya Krishnan, Yogi Babu, Mirnaa and Rithvik reprising their roles from the predecessor, with S. J. Suryah, Mithun Chakraborty, Suraj Venjaramoodu and Vidya Balan joining the cast.

questions.question: Which controversial company, founded by Elizabeth Holmes in 2003, falsely claimed to have developed revolutionary blood-testing technology?
questions.explanation: Theranos raised hundreds of millions of dollars on promises of cutting-edge blood diagnostic technology before collapsing amidst fraud convictions.
questions.context: Theranos (American health-technology company): Theranos Inc. was an American privately held corporation that was touted as a breakthrough health technology company. Founded in 2003 by then–19-year-old Elizabeth Holmes, Theranos raised more than US$700 million from venture capitalists and private investors, resulting in a $9 billion valuation at its peak in 2013 and 2014.

questions.question: Which ancient Egyptian deity was classically depicted wearing the atef crown and carrying a crook and flail?
questions.explanation: In ancient Egyptian religion, Osiris was usually shown bearing a pharaoh's beard, an atef crown, and holding the symbolic shepherd's crook and flail.
questions.context: Osiris (Ancient Egyptian god of the afterlife): Osiris was the god of fertility, agriculture, the afterlife, the dead, resurrection, life, and vegetation in ancient Egyptian religion. He was classically depicted with a pharaoh's beard, partially mummy-wrapped at the legs, wearing a distinctive atef crown and holding a symbolic crook and flail. He was one of the first to be associated with the mummy wrap.

questions.question: Which television spin-off of the miniseries WandaVision was created for Disney+ by Terry Matalas?
questions.explanation: Terry Matalas created VisionQuest as an MCU series based on the character Vision, serving as a spin-off to WandaVision.
questions.context: VisionQuest (Marvel Studios television miniseries): VisionQuest is an American television miniseries created by Terry Matalas for the streaming service Disney+, based on Marvel Comics featuring the character Vision. A spin-off from the miniseries WandaVision (2021), it is the 18th television series in the Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU) from Marvel Studios and is produced under its Marvel Television label. The series shares continuity with the films of the MCU.
